facts.question: Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?

Was the notice given while the probation period was still running, counting any extension of the probation period under art. 335b para. 3 (a probation period interrupted by illness, accident or a non-voluntary legal obligation is extended accordingly)?
Does the file say that a written individual agreement, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract set a probation period other than the first month of employment?

Was the employee, through no fault of their own, wholly or partly prevented from working by illness or accident on the day notice was given or at some time while the notice period was running, and was the incapacity at that point still within its protected length: up to 30 days in the first year of service, 90 days in the second to fifth years, 180 days from the sixth year?

Was the employee performing Swiss compulsory military service, civil defence service or alternative civilian service on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running, or, for such a service lasting more than eleven days, did either of those fall within the four weeks before or after it?
Was the employee pregnant, or within sixteen weeks after giving birth, on the day notice was given or while the notice period was running?

Where a protected period (illness or accident, compulsory service, pregnancy or birth, as above) is raised: was the notice given before that period began, with the notice period not yet expired when it began?

Does the file say that a written individual employment contract, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract sets notice periods different from the statutory ones (seven days during probation, art. 335b para. 1; one month in the first year of service, two months in the second to ninth years, three months thereafter)?

facts.question: Did the employer give the employee notice of termination of the employment relationship?
Has the notice period (from the notice to the end of the employment relationship) already ended?
Did the employee lodge a written objection to the notice with the employer (German: "beim Kündigenden schriftlich Einsprache erheben") no later than the end of the notice period?
Did the employee and the employer agree, after the notice, that the employment relationship would continue?
Have more than 180 days passed since the employment relationship ended?
Did the employee make the compensation claim pending (German: "Klage anhängig gemacht") within 180 days of the end of the employment relationship?
Did the employee ask the employer to state the reasons for the notice in writing?
Was the notice given because the employee had asserted, in good faith, claims arising from the employment relationship?
Was the employee, when notice was given, an elected employee representative on the staff council of the business or on a body linked to the business?

facts.question: Did the employer end the employment relationship with immediate effect, without a notice period?
Did the employee ask the employer to state the reasons for the immediate dismissal in writing?

Does the employer give as the cause of the dismissal the employee's absence from work, and does the employee say they were prevented from working through no fault of their own (for instance illness, accident or a non-voluntary legal obligation)?
Was the employment relationship agreed for a fixed term, with an agreed end date, rather than for an unlimited period?

Does the file say that a written individual employment contract, a standard employment contract or a collective employment contract sets notice periods different from the statutory ones (seven days during probation, art. 335b para. 1; one month in the first year of service, two months in the second to ninth years, three months thereafter)?
Has the employee earned income from other work during the time the notice period or the agreed term would still have run?
